newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania's gas firm owes $34 mln to Russia.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania's gas firm owes $34 mln to Russia.

text.p: Lithuania's state run gas firm Lithuanian Gas Co said on Monday it owed $34 million to natural gas suppliers in Russia.
Martynas Bartys, the head of Lithuanian Gas' commerce department, said it owed $18.1 million to Gazprom and $15.9 million to an intermediary company, Stella Vitae.

Lithuanian Gas has had big problems repaying debts to Russian suppliers as it itself is owed millions by Lithuanian companies. Russia has several times threatened to cut off Lithuania's gas supply due to unpaid debts.
The debt was slightly lower than at the start of February when it was $34.4 million. The debt this time last year was $54.8, Bartys added.
"Our biggest customer Lietuvos Energija owes us $38.9 million and we are pushed into debt too," Bartys said.
Lietuvos Energija earlier said it signed a $50 million loan agreement on Friday with investment bank Merrill Lynch to pay its debt to Lithuanian Gas.
"Leading company officials will go to Moscow on Wednesday to discuss further payments and gas supplies," Bartys said.
